paragraphs.text: Syr Konrad , the Grim , is a human knight of Eldraine .

Syr Konrad is a knight of Locthwain . While not much is known about his background, it is known that the knights of Locthwain are haughty and believe themselves to be superior to other knights by their devotion to the highest virtue. They are known to be pragmatic and will flee a losing battle. but their persistence ensures that they will find another way to return and defeat their enemies. It is said that one should avoid making an enemy of a Locthwain knight over trivial matters as they are famous in the realm for holding lifelong grudges.

Locthwain's knights always look ready for one of Queen Ayara elaborate parties even when armored. Their highest aspiration is to become worthy of undertaking the quest for the Cauldron of Eternity and possibly wed the queen before setting out on the quest. Before such an undertaking they prove their worth questing for other magical gifts to curry favor with her.
